A prominent, easily recognized constellation in the night sky (the Hunter).
Here it appears in porquinho-da-índia ('guinea pig'). Note: 'índia' alone can mean 'Indian (female)'; capitalized 'Índia' is the country India.
Common noun: 'iris' (flower or part of the eye). Appears in 'arco-íris' = 'rainbow'. As a proper name it would be 'Íris' (the given name Iris).
